text:
Ana (eng): Quick proposal — run a 2-week pilot to compress our weekly triage into a 20min "mini-standup". Reason: fewer long tangents, faster owner assignment, clearer async followups. Proposed format: 

- 2 min: quick status roll call (who's blocked)
- 8 min: urgent/high-priority bugs (owner + ETA)
- 6 min: owner quick updates on ongoing high-risk items
- 4 min: 1 quick backlog highlight for grooming + action owner

Example agenda snippet to copy into the invite:

```
Wed 10:00 PT — 20m Mini Triage (pilot)
1) Roll call — blocked? (2m)
2) Hot bugs — owner, ETA (8m)
3) Owner updates — blockers + ask (6m)
4) Backlog highlight — pick 1 item, owner to follow up (4m)
Action: owners add follow-up threads for details, mark with `triage:owner` tag.
```

Thoughts? I can update the recurring invite if we agree on time (Wed 10 PT) and chair rotation. :calendar:  :hourglass_flowing_sand:

Mike R: I like the short window. Two quick asks: 1) rotate chair weekly (infra/runtime/platform) so we don't bottleneck, 2) make sure on-call has a 30s slot to flag paging churn so it doesn't get lost. :thumbsup:

Samir: +1. Also propose an async pre-thread — everyone drops any new bugs by Tue EOD with a 1-line summary and severity tag. That'll make the 8m hot-bugs slot focused. Example message format: `BUG-1234 | sev=1 | brief: memory OOM on batch job | suspect: quantization changes`

Jen L: Can we record notes in a GH issue template or a pinned doc? I worry about lost context. Also prefer Wed 09:30 PT if our EU folks need slightly earlier. If Wed 10 stays, I'm fine if we rotate times every other week.

Ana (eng): Good call on pre-thread and notes. Agreed to trial Wed 10 PT this month and collect feedback. I'll add a pinned doc template: `triage/ministandup-notes.md` with fields: owners, actions, follow-up thread link. On rotating time, let's keep constant for the pilot to reduce variables.

Mike R: I'll chair week 1. I'll also add a short section in the invite: "Pre-thread: drop items by Tue EOD tagged #triage". I can update the calendar now.

InfraBot: Reminder set — new recurring event created by Mike R for Wed 10:00 PT, 20m, attendees: eng@redwood.ics. First occurrence: 1772563200.

Samir: If folks agree, I'll draft the pre-thread template and post it here by EOD today. Also propose we auto-assign any unclaimed hot-bug to the oncall after the meeting if nobody volunteers within 24h.

Jen L: :+1: on auto-assign fallback. Also we'll need an owner convention: `triage-owner: @handle` in the follow-up thread to make console searches easier.

Ana (eng): Sounds like consensus. Plan: 1) Mike creates invite and pins doc, 2) Samir posts pre-thread template, 3) we run 2-week pilot starting next Wed 10 PT, 4) collect feedback in the pinned doc and decide whether to keep/adjust. I'll post a brief recap here once the invite is up. Thanks all. :rocket:

Mike R: Done — invite up and doc pinned. See you next Wed. :coffee:

(threads: compact, focused — try to keep replies short during the meeting and move detailed discussion to follow-up threads.)
